content_sections.heading: BBAU Project Associate-I/JRF Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is as per ANRF guidelines. Candidates must have completed their M.Sc. Degree in Geology/Earth Science/Environmental Science/Life Sciences. Good knowledge, experience or publications in analytical/microbial techniques used in water and sediment analysis. All things being equal, SC/ST candidates will be preferred as per GOI rules. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The appointment is initially for one year. It is extendable for two (1+1) more years or till completion of the project (whichever is later), based on satisfactory performance. The position is prone to termination upon unsatisfactory performance, on one month of prior notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBAU Project Associate-I/JRF Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Write your application on plain paper, giving your name, permanent and correspondence address, names of father and mother, telephone number and e-mail address. Add details of your educational career, starting from High School or equivalent. Add details of any research or other experience. Attach self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates. Appear for the interview in the Department of Environmental Science, Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University, Lucknow - 226025. The university's website will carry any update or modification, so check it regularly before the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Which M.Sc. subjects are accepted for the BBAU JRF post?
faq.answer: The notice accepts an M.Sc. in any of four subjects: Geology, Earth Science, Environmental Science or Life Sciences.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets Rs. 37,000/- instead of Rs. 30,000/-?
faq.answer: Scholars selected through CSIR-UGC NET, including lectureship, or through a national level examination conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions get Rs. 37,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring your plain-paper application with your personal, educational and experience details, along with self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: It starts with one year and can be extended by two (1+1) more years or till completion of the project, whichever is later.

faq.question: Q5. Will BBAU pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be paid for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. What will the project work involve?
faq.answer: The ANRF-sponsored project covers hydrological mapping of Arsenic and Fluoride in the Ganga - Gomti Doab, including their co-occurrence, environmental dynamism and sustainable mitigation methods.
